[1mDESCRIPTION[0m
  Make a request to the running server

[1mUSAGE[0m
  [36mopencode api [flags] <operation | method path...>[0m

[1mARGUMENTS[0m
  [32moperation | method path...[0m [2mstring[0m OpenAPI operation ID, or an HTTP method followed by a path

[1mFLAGS[0m
  [32m--data[0m, [32m-d[0m [2mstring[0m      Request body
  [32m--header[0m, [32m-H[0m [2mstring[0m    Request header in name:value form
  [32m--param[0m [2mkey=value[0m      OpenAPI path or query parameter

[1mGLOBAL FLAGS[0m
  [32m--help[0m, [32m-h[0m                                                          Show help information
  [32m--version[0m, [32m-v[0m                                                       Show version information
  [32m--wizard[0m                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  [32m--completions[0m [2m<bash|zsh|fish|powershell|sh|pwsh>[0m                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, powershell, sh, pwsh)
  [32m--log-level[0m [2m<all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>[0m    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)
  [32m--print-logs[0m                                                        Print logs to stderr (server logs require --standalone)
  [32m--standalone[0m                                                        Run with a private server instead of the background service
  [32m--server[0m [2mstring[0m                                                     Connect to a server URL instead of the background service
